mapper.select: SELECT ei.id, ei.name, ei.order_num eventNumber, ei.appear_time, ei.subject_address, ei.handle_status, ei.event_source, ei.incident_area, ei.lable, ei.take_place, ei.take_address, ea.attention_status, ei.system_source, ei.unit_source, ei.send_time, ei.unit_username, ei.decision_person_name, ei.read_person_name FROM event_attention ea LEFT JOIN event_info ei ON ea.event_id = ei.id WHERE ea.attention_status=1 and ea.user_id = #{userId} order by ea.created_time desc
SELECT ei.id, ei.audit_push_time pushTime FROM event_info ei WHERE ei.audit_push_time BETWEEN #{beginDate} AND #{endDate} AND ei.examine_status=0
SELECT ei.related_field, ei.organizer, ei.event_class, ei.event_source FROM event_info ei GROUP BY ei.related_field, ei.organizer, ei.event_class, ei.event_source
SELECT * FROM event_info WHERE street_name is null OR street_name='';
